name: voyagier
description: Book real travel from your agent — flights, hotels & activities behind a price-gated checkout.
long_description: Voyagier lets AI agents plan and book real trips: search flights, hotels & activities, assemble trip plans, and check out through a price-gated booking flow that fails closed on price drift. Access is by invitation — request access and get your Personal Access Token at https://www.voyagier.com/agents.

voyagier_token.title: Voyagier Personal Access Token
voyagier_token.description: Create at travel.voyagier.com → Settings → Personal Access Tokens. Access is by invitation — request at https://www.voyagier.com/agents.
